title: Ledger Bench
summary: A reconciliation console that replaces spreadsheet chaos with calm, auditable workflows.
problem: Ops teams in Mumbai and Pune were drowning in brittle spreadsheets and overnight batch jobs with no clear ownership.
approach: We mapped the real desk rituals, then rebuilt the flow around exceptions—not every row.
outcome: Month-end close dropped from five days to one and a half, with a full audit trail.
